profile.headline: Staff Software Developer at UncommonGoods
profile.summary:
I am a Full-Stack Staff Software Engineer and systems architect who builds high-throughput, event-driven backends and complex reactive user interfaces, creating scalable end-to-end systems with a rigorous focus on usability. I have a track record of taking new products from the whiteboard to production, building the tooling and infrastructure that makes distributed teams more productive, and modernizing legacy systems.
I like film photography, skateboarding, and pizza.

positions.title: Staff Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and built a migration to a pick-to-box fulfillment model within the warehouse management system (WMS), replacing the legacy pick-to-tote flow to drive a major decrease in holiday peak labor spend.
- Created an end-to-end system to consolidate shipments across distinct outbound warehouse zones, eliminating redundant multi-package shipping and generating significant annual freight savings.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
- Rewrote the outbound WMS core engine in Java and Vert.x using event-driven reactive programming; deployed as a headless Kubernetes service to split orders, compute pick paths, and route logistics, eliminating database outages under holiday peak load.

- Designed and implemented the WMS's Vue front-end: a supervisor dashboard routing warehouse workloads into speed tiers, giving leads real-time pacing control and boosting order pick/pack efficiency; partnered directly with warehouse supervisors as an internal user researcher and product lead on the UI design.

- Led and mentored two developers during the WMS rewrite, authoring technical specifications and reviewing pull requests.

- Initiated and shipped a specialized variant of the in-house shipping platform, tailored to UG's vertically integrated manufacturing workflows, reducing manufacturing shipping costs by 35%.

- Architected and carried out an overhaul of the Jenkins CI/CD infrastructure supporting hundreds of pipelines, accelerating site builds by minutes and doubling execution speed across critical jobs.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Built Tugboat, the company's first desktop app (NodeJS/TypeScript Electron app and companion web service wrapping the EasyPost API), saving money on an expensive outside software vendor; accelerated label generation and moved rate-shopping logic in-house.

- Wrote the base-image Dockerfile for uncommongoods.com's initial Kubernetes implementation, and partnered with engineering management to rework Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, putting release promotion workflows directly into QA's hands.

positions.title: Pyramid Teacher
positions.description:
Full-time substitute teacher

- Passed ESL, Pedagogy and Personal Responsibility, and Texas Examinations of Educator Standards Exams
